admin/editor.recommendation-shelf.descri: Recommendation Shelf is a component that displays a collection of items that are recommended to the user based on various algorithms and context data.
admin/editor.recommendation-shelf.title: Shelf title
admin/editor.recommendation-shelf.items-: From where to retrieve the items that will be used as context in the Recommendation request
admin/editor.recommendation-shelf.hidden: URL paths where the shelf should not be displayed. Use exact paths (e.g. /checkout/cart) or prefix wildcards with * (e.g. /produto/*).
admin/editor.recommendation-shelf.displa: Whether to display a loading placeholder while the shelf is loading.
admin/editor.recommendation-shelf.loadin: The number of loading placeholders to display per device type while loading.
